rationale: A Roberts or Kagan majority opinion is most likely, narrowly applying Coy and Craig to require an individualized, on-the-record necessity finding before using a screen and remanding without resolving harmlessness. Separate concurrences are most likely from Thomas and Gorsuch (originalist/separation-of-powers framing) and possibly Alito (emphasizing child-protection interests and harmless-error limits) while still joining the judgment.
